answer: Deposits are visible in comet, and saffron reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 74 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 18 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
